title: Agentic AI uncovers conserved cross-tissue protein co-abundance programs inaccessible to single-dataset analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.28990v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Protein co-abundance clusters preserved across tissues can reveal shared disease mechanisms and candidate therapeutic targets, particularly when proteins implicated in organ-confined diseases converge in peripheral or accessible tissues. However, previous cross-tissue studies have focused on biologically pre-selected tissue pairs, leaving most possible combinations and non-obvious relationships unexplored. We present an LLM-agent framework for large-scale, evidence-grounded comparison of tissue-specific protein co-abundance networks. The framework constructs tissue networks, derives pairwise consensus clusters, and integrates evidence from expression atlases, protein interaction and complex databases, pathway annotations, disease catalogues, and literature. translated_title: 智能体AI揭示了单数据集分析无法触及的跨组织蛋白质共丰度保守程序
translated_abstract: 跨组织保守的蛋白质共丰度聚类可以揭示共同的疾病机制和候选治疗靶点，尤其是当涉及器官局限性疾病的相关蛋白质在外周或易获取组织中汇聚时。然而，以往的跨组织研究主要集中在生物学上预先选择的组织对，使大多数可能的组合和非显而易见的关系未被探索。我们提出了一个基于大语言模型的智能体框架，用于大规模、有证据支持的特定组织蛋白质共丰度网络比较。该框架构建组织网络，推导成对共识聚类，并整合来自表达图谱、蛋白质相互作用和复合物数据库、通路注释、疾病目录以及文献的证据。应用于41种人体组织和体液的全部820种成对组合后，该框架在406个组织对中识别出1,833个保守的共丰度聚类，涉及结肠、滑液、血液、脑脊液等组织体液。
tldr: 该研究提出一个基于大语言模型的智能体框架，系统比较了41种人体组织和体液全部820种成对组合的蛋白质共丰度网络，发现1,833个跨组织保守的共丰度聚类，揭示了单数据集分析无法发现的跨组织共享疾病机制与治疗靶点。
en_tdlr: This study introduces an LLM-agent framework that systematically compares protein co-abundance networks across all 820 pairwise combinations of 41 human tissues and fluids, uncovering 1,833 conserved cross-tissue co-abundance clusters that reveal shared disease mechanisms and therapeutic targets inaccessible to single-dataset analysis.
